NewsArticle.Title: Shrine Entrances
NewsArticle.Content:
Shrine exits become five times as large in response to the growing numbers of worshippers, especially at mass. Mundanes rebuilt the Shrine of Glioca, whose fellowship is by far the largest, to be slightly larger.
[Click here](http://www.darkages.com/2000/play/s_religion.html) and speak to shrine attendants and priests to learn more about religions.
